name: FEMBOY HOTEL
source:
These are hard times—job offers are scarce, and the economy keeps getting worse. But luckily, you’ve landed an interview at the prestigious (and long-forgotten) Trapfield Hotel.

A peculiar hotel, nestled in a once-thriving tourist city now past its prime, owned by the mysterious woman who bears its name: the feared Mrs. Trapfield.

You don’t believe the legends about the place, but the rumors say anyone who steps foot inside will be cursed—their life changed forever… though whether for better or worse, no one knows.

Will you earn your living in this disgraced hotel filled with horny FUTANARIS, hyper-endowed FEMBOYS, and GHOSTS? Will you uncover all its mysteries? Or will you pussy-out?

It’s all up to you, FEMBOY.

一家奇特的酒店坐落在一座曾经繁荣的旅游城市，如今已经过了鼎盛时期，酒店的主人是一位以其名字命名的神秘女人：令人畏惧的特拉普菲尔德夫人。

你不相信关于这个地方的传说，但有传言说任何踏入其中的人都会受到诅咒——他们的生活永远改变了……尽管是好还是坏，没有人知道。
